llm.summary: The skill’s main data-query purpose is clear, but it also tells the agent to install and upgrade host tools and configure API credentials, so it needs review before use.

dimensions.detail: Installing Node and qhkit can be purpose-aligned for this tool, but doing so from runtime instructions expands the host environment more than a narrow replay-query skill requires.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The metadata declares a qhkit Node package dependency, but the skill body also instructs global npm installs, unpinned npx fallback, @latest upgrades, and direct Node binary download/install steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording includes broad same-kind requests and the runtime instructions tell the agent to self-bootstrap missing dependencies instead of stopping for explicit user-directed setup.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill directs creation of files under $HOME/.local/lib, PATH changes, possible shell-profile persistence, global package installation, and qhkit token configuration; these are disclosed but persistent and under-scoped.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: query WeChat Channels live replay history through qhkit fetch_live_history, with paid-call disclosure and per-session user approval before billable calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with qhkit accessing the Qinghu service using your token and consuming Qinghu credits. Prefer a pre-provisioned or version-pinned qhkit installation, avoid letting the skill modify shell startup files automatically, and review any global npm, Node, or token-configuration step before allowing it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: Verified broad trigger language in SKILL.md. The examples are related to live replay queries, but the loose phrasing can activate the skill in ambiguous contexts where paid calls or setup could follow.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified host bootstrapping instructions for qhkit, Node/npm, and credentials. Dependency setup is related to the tool, but runtime-driven global installation and credential configuration are broader than the core query purpose.
[RP1] unexpected: Verified fallback use of npx @iqinghu/qhkit without an exact version pin. This is a supply-chain reproducibility concern, not evidence of malicious behavior.
[RA2] unexpected: Verified the Node binary extraction into the user home directory and PATH modification instructions. The duplicate scanner entries refer to the same persistence-related evidence.
